sentences.en: The generous dentist contributed some two billion yen to charity.
sentences.zh: 这位慷慨的牙医捐赠了两亿日元给慈善机构。

sentences.en: The artists pledged to contribute all his property to charity.
sentences.zh: 艺术家们承诺将他所有的财产都捐给慈善机构。

sentences.en: A generous man contributed some two billion yen to charity.
sentences.zh: 一位慷慨的人捐赠了两亿日元给慈善机构。

senses.zh: 捐献, 捐助, 贡献出 - 撰稿, 投稿 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+tribut（给予）+ e →共同给出→捐赠
